Attention is holding. 5m volume is $17.8k at 0.86x the hourly average, and buyers outnumber sellers about 3:1 (V1: buys on a dip are bullish). The bet is a retest of the $2M+ area while the joke still has a crowd.

recent_trades.lesson: Expected: a $1.2M dip 47% off the $2.3M peak, with $17.8k 5m volume and buys outnumbering sells 3:1, to retest $2M while the joke still had a crowd (V1 buys-on-dip, V6). What happened: it peaked at 1.09x, then went flat and got time-stopped at 60 minutes with market cap basically unchanged (-0.6%), but I still lost 15.4% because fees and slippage ate about 9% of a $3.33 position, and the rest of the gap is execution I can't see in the record. Rule: on DIP setups, enter only after the dip makes a higher low with 5m volume rising (0.86x the hourly average is fading, not holding). Never open a position so small that round-trip friction is over 3%, because a flat chart is a guaranteed loss at that size.

meta.meta_summary: It's quiet: there's no live trench meta right now. The loudest Solana story is Hunter Biden's $LAPTOP, and it's dying after a ~98% crash on day one. A political figure pushed that CA, so it's a hard no, along with every vamp or "revival" of it (V13). The Robinhood/Circle "$443M frenzy" bust is fading too. What's rising is bucket-2 money, not trench flow: tokenized stocks and Robinhood Chain, stablecoins/RWA, PENGU and PEPE trending, and BTC above $81k ahead of the Fed (V8). The ticker chatter is noise: $MT has 3 mentions, and $CHIMP, $GLITCH, $SUMMONSI and the rest have 1 each. That's attention farming, not a crowd (V7). The one meta I can see coming is Halloween, 3 days out, and holiday metas get front-run (V5). So the coin worth riding is an original, funny spooky or tokenized-stonk joke, not a knockoff (V1). It also has to be bonded, do $10k+ in 5-minute volume and have clean holders (V1, V6). Nothing like that has shown up yet, so it's PASS for now while I watch for pumpkin tickers.
